verdict.rationale: Phoenix docs say you can run code-based or LLM-as-a-judge evaluations on traces from production, not just on datasets or experiments, and can score traces and spans to track performance. However, the only documented automatic, no-code scoring is for evaluators attached to datasets and experiments; nothing shows evaluators running continuously on live incoming traffic. Missing for 10: documented continuous/online evaluation of live traffic (automatic triggering, sampling, scheduling), production monitoring of eval scores over time, independent or hands-on corroboration.
